title: when a slice changes a role prompt's tool instruction, grep docs/ for the old command name and list the hits in the brief

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (deterministic-check) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-163840-c68e, item S559: when a slice changes a role prompt's tool instruction, grep `docs/` for the old command name and list the hits in the brief. The evidence is that `docs/design.md` still said `adj find` after `internal/roles/prompts/spec-check.md:76-77` changed to `adj check TEXT`. Nothing today tells the reviewer or the gate to look for such stale text, so it passes review.

The owner decided how to build it (session 8d711f67, 2026-11-25 and 2026-11-26). ork code finds the command names that the branch diff removes from role-prompt text in `internal/roles`. It greps `docs/` in the worktree for them and lists each `file:line` hit in a `Stale doc references` section of the reviewer and gate briefs. Every command name in a removed line is searched, even if the same name is added back elsewhere (adj 598). A command name is the first two lowercase words of a backticked span, such as `adj check`, `slicer show` or `go test`. A span whose second word is a flag or has an uppercase letter gives no name (adj 599, `review.stale-doc-command-name`). The section is advisory, never blocks or pauses a run, and lists at most 20 hits.

Owner decisions, 2026-11-26: adj 598 (every command name in a removed prompt line is searched, even if added back) and adj 599 (a command name is the first two lowercase words of a backticked span).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
These tests drive pure functions with in-memory text or a temp `docs/` tree.
- TestStaleDocsCommandNames: `staleDocNames` takes removed lines and returns the sorted, de-duplicated command names.
  - "Never use `adj find`." gives `adj find`.
  - "`adj check TEXT`" gives `adj check`.
  - "`slicer show S05 --root DIR`" gives `slicer show`.
  - A line with two spans gives both names.
  - These give nothing: "`go -C DIR test`" (flag as second word), "`adj KEY`" (uppercase second word), "`ork`" (one word) and an unpaired backtick.
- TestStaleDocsRemovedLines: `removedPromptLines` reads a `git diff --unified=0` text and returns only the removed lines. It drops the `--- a/...` and `+++` header lines, keeps a removed line whose text starts with `-- ` (shown as `--- `) because it comes after an `@@` line, and ignores added lines.
- TestStaleDocsHits: `staleDocHits` walks a temp `docs/` tree for names `adj find` and `adj check`.
  - It returns `docs/a.md:3` and `docs/sub/b.md:7`, sorted by file then line.
  - A line holding both names appears once and lists both.
  - `adj finder` and `badj find` do not match, but a match at the start or end of a line does.
  - A missing `docs/` directory gives no hits and no error.
- TestStaleDocsHitLimit: with 25 matching lines the section lists the first 20 in sorted order and says 5 were left out.

These tests run a round in the harness, with real files written under `h.W` and the diff route of `staleDocsDiffRoute` (defined in `staledocs_test.go`):
- TestStaleDocsReviewerAndGateBriefs: the removed lines name `adj find` and `docs/design.md` line 4 says `adj find`. The reviewer brief and the gate brief both hold a `## Stale doc references` section listing `docs/design.md:4` and `adj find`, and say it is advisory. The architect brief has none. The run still ends in `StateAwaitingApproval`.
- TestStaleDocsSearchesNameAddedBackElsewhere: the diff removes a line naming `adj find` and adds another line that names `adj find`. The section still lists the docs hits for `adj find`.
- TestStaleDocsNoSectionWithoutHits: an empty diff gives no section. Removed lines naming `adj find` with no match in `docs/` also give no section.
- TestStaleDocsAdvisory: a failed diff read or merge-base read, and an unreadable file under `docs/`, each add a `Check incomplete` notice that says `does not block the run`. The run is not paused.

These existing tests change because the gate now reads the branch too:
- TestBaseOverlayAndUntestedCallSitesShareOneBranchRead: each branch read (`symbolic-ref`, `merge-base`, `diff --name-only`, `ls-files`) now happens once per reviewer round and once per gate round.
- TestAProblemWithNoItemOrAStaleRenderStaysRed: the `symbolic-ref` count now equals reviewer rounds plus gate rounds.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Create `internal/engine/staledocs.go` with the SPDX header. Add the pure function `removedPromptLines(diff string) []string`. Walk the diff lines and keep a per-file state: it is in a header from a `diff --git` line until the next `@@` line. Outside a header, a line that starts with `-` is a removed line, returned without its leading `-`.
2. Add the pure function `staleDocNames(lines []string) []string`.
   - Find every single-line span of the form `` `[^`]+` ``.
   - Split each span with `strings.Fields`. A span with fewer than two words gives no name.
   - The first and second words must each match `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$`. A flag (second word starting with `-`) or an uppercase second word gives no name (adj 599).
   - The name is the two words joined by one space. Return the names sorted and de-duplicated. Search every name from a removed line (adj 598), and do not drop a name because the diff adds it back.
3. Add the type `staleDocHit` (path relative to the worktree, line number, names matched) and the function `staleDocHits(worktree string, names []string) ([]staleDocHit, []string)`.
   - Walk `filepath.WalkDir` over `worktree/docs`. A missing directory gives no hits and no error.
   - Read each regular file. Report each path that cannot be read in the second result.
   - Match each name case-sensitively as a literal, where the characters before and after it are not in `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`, or the match is at the line's edge.
   - Give one hit per `file:line` that lists every name matched on it. Sort by file, then line.
4. Add `const staleDocsLimit = 20` and `func (e *Engine) staleDocsSection(ctx context.Context, rec runrec.Record, change branchChangeResult) *BriefSection`, titled `Stale doc references`. Model it on `untestedCallSitesSection` in `internal/engine/untestedcallsites.go`.
   - If `change.Err` is set or `change.MergeBase` is empty, return the notice "Check incomplete: the branch diff against the base could not be read. Search `docs/` yourself for any command name the branch removed from role prompt text in `internal/roles`; this does not block the run."
   - Otherwise read `e.gitRead(ctx, rec.Worktree, "diff", "--no-color", "--no-ext-diff", "--no-renames", "--unified=0", change.MergeBase, "--", "internal/roles", ":(exclude)internal/roles/*_test.go")`. This covers the prompt files under `internal/roles/prompts` and the prompt text in `internal/roles/roles.go`. A failed read gives a notice like the one above, worded for the removed lines.
   - Run `removedPromptLines`, `staleDocNames` and `staleDocHits`.
   - Return nil when there are no names, or when there are no hits and no unreadable files.
   - Body: one plain paragraph that says the removed role prompt lines named these commands (each in backticks), that `docs/` still names them at the places below, that the reviewer or gate should check whether each still describes the prompt as it now reads, and that the check goes by text, so it is advisory and never blocks the run.
   - Then one line per hit, `- `docs/design.md:3122`: `adj find``, listing every matched name.
   - Cap the list at `staleDocsLimit`, and say how many more were left out.
   - Add a `Check incomplete:` line naming any unreadable doc files.
5. In `internal/engine/round.go`, in the `if r.role == RoleReviewer` block (lines 607-619), add `staleDocsSection(ctx, rec, change)` to `in.Sections` after `untestedCallSitesSection`, when it is not nil. Add a matching `if r.role == RoleGate` step that calls `e.branchChange(ctx, rec)`, builds a `branchChangeResult` the same way, and adds the section to `in.Sections` before the `Ork round check result` section is appended (lines 639-666). The architect gets none.
6. In `internal/engine/staledocs_test.go` (new, with the SPDX header), add `staleDocsDiffRoute(W, stdout string) clitest.Route` for the exact `git -C W diff ...` call from step 4 with merge base `base`. Add the tests named under Failing tests, using `ucsReviewerHarness`, `ucsWrite`, `architectHarness` and `baseOverlayRoutes` for the harness tests.
7. In `internal/engine/baseoverlay_test.go:44-53` and `internal/engine/engine_test.go:965`, change the expected branch-read counts from one per reviewer round to one per reviewer round plus one per gate round, and update the comments.
8. In `docs/design.md`, after the `## Untested call sites` bullet (line 2105, before "earlier reports"), add a bullet for the `## Stale doc references` section (S569, adj 598, adj 599, `review.stale-doc-command-name`).
   - Cover the diff read of `internal/roles` (test files excluded) against the merge base, and how a command name is found (first two lowercase words of a backticked span; a flag or uppercase second word gives none).
   - Cover that every name in a removed line is searched even if added back, the `docs/` text search with word-boundary matching, the 20-hit cap with a left-out count, and the incomplete-check notice.
   - Say that it is advisory and never blocks or pauses a run, and that the reviewer and the gate get it and the architect does not.
9. Run `slicer changelog add S569 --text "The reviewer and gate briefs now list docs/ lines that still name a command a role prompt change removed, as an advisory section."` It writes `landed-changed/S569.md`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -run TestStaleDocsCommandNames ./internal/engine`: passes.
- `go test -run TestStaleDocsRemovedLines ./internal/engine`: passes.
- `go test -run TestStaleDocsHits ./internal/engine`: passes.
- `go test -run TestStaleDocsHitLimit ./internal/engine`: passes.
- `go test -run TestStaleDocsReviewerAndGateBriefs ./internal/engine`: passes.
- `go test -run TestStaleDocsSearchesNameAddedBackElsewhere ./internal/engine`: passes.
- `go test -run TestStaleDocsNoSectionWithoutHits ./internal/engine`: passes.
- `go test -run TestStaleDocsAdvisory ./internal/engine`: passes.
- `go test -run TestBaseOverlayAndUntestedCallSitesShareOneBranchRead ./internal/engine`: passes with the counts of reviewer plus gate rounds.
- `go test -run TestAProblemWithNoItemOrAStaleRenderStaysRed ./internal/engine`: passes with the counts of reviewer plus gate rounds.
- `go test ./...`: all packages pass.
- `go vet ./...`: no output.
- `gofmt -l .`: no output.
- `slicer check`: no problems.
- [HUMAN CHECK] In the next real reviewer round for a slice that removes a backticked command from a role prompt that docs/ still names, open the reviewer's brief under the run's role files. You should see a ## Stale doc references section listing each docs/...:LINE hit with the command name, and the gate's brief should hold the same section. The run should not have paused for it.
